fine_lines.title: take off vs take out
fine_lines.explanation_ar: take off = يخلع (الحذاء أو المعطف) أو تقلع الطائرة. take out = يُخرج شيئًا من الحقيبة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Take off" = remove clothes/shoes (or a plane leaves the ground). "Take out" = remove something from a bag.

examples.sentence: Do I need to take off my shoes?

fine_lines.title: luggage vs bag
fine_lines.explanation_ar: luggage اسم غير معدود (لا جمع له). bag معدود: one bag, two bags.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Luggage" is uncountable. "Bag" is countable: one bag, two bags.

examples.sentence: How much luggage can I take?
Do I have to pay for an extra bag?

fine_lines.title: Do I need to vs Do I have to
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما للسؤال عن الضرورة. Do I have to يسأل عن قاعدة إجبارية، وDo I need to يسأل هل هو ضروري. في المطار كلاهما صحيح.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both ask if something is necessary. "Have to" sounds more like a rule; "need to" asks if it's needed. Both work at the airport.

examples.sentence: Do I need to take off my shoes?
Do I have to pay extra for this bag?

grammar.title: Do I have to / Do I need to + verb?
grammar.explanation_ar: نسأل عن شيء ضروري أو إجباري بـ Do I have to + فعل أصلي أو Do I need to + فعل أصلي. الجواب: Yes, you do / No, you don't.
grammar.explanation_en: Ask if something is necessary with "Do I have to + base verb?" or "Do I need to + base verb?" Answer: Yes, you do / No, you don't.
examples: Do I have to pay extra?
Do I need to take off my shoes?
Do I need to take out my laptop?

grammar.title: Where can I + verb? / How do I get to...?
grammar.explanation_ar: Where can I + فعل أصلي للسؤال عن مكان فعل شيء. How do I get to + مكان للسؤال عن الطريق.
grammar.explanation_en: "Where can I + base verb?" asks where to do something. "How do I get to + place?" asks for directions.
examples: Where can I weigh my luggage?
How do I get to the departure gates?

grammar.title: Present perfect question: Has boarding started?
grammar.explanation_ar: نسأل هل حدث شيء حتى الآن بـ Has/Have + الفاعل + التصريف الثالث. Has boarding started? = هل بدأ الصعود (حتى الآن)؟
grammar.explanation_en: Ask if something has happened up to now: Has/Have + subject + past participle.

questions.question: At security, they ask you to remove your shoes. The question is: "Do I need to take ___ my shoes?"

questions.explanation_en: Present perfect: Has + subject + past participle.
